title: Scaling accounting capacity with OpenAI
summary: Built with OpenAI o3, o3-Pro, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5, Basis’ AI agents help accounting firms save up to 30% of their time and expand capacity for advisory and growth.
body: Built with OpenAI o3, o3-Pro, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5, Basis’ AI agents help accounting firms save up to 30% of their time and expand capacity for advisory and growth.
summaryZh: Basis基于OpenAI的o3、o3-Pro、GPT-4.1和GPT-5等模型推出了会计AI智能体，能够帮助会计事务所节省高达30%的时间，并扩展其咨询与增长业务能力。原始信息显示：Built with OpenAI o3, o3-Pro, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5, Basis’ AI agents help accounting firms save up to 30% of their time and expand capacity for advisory and growth.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Scaling accounting capacity with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：Basis利用OpenAI的最新模型构建会计AI智能体，帮助企业节省时间并扩展业务能力。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
